summary: CCEP filed a Form 6-K announcing that independent non-executive director Nathalie Gaveau resigned from the Board effective 16 September 2026, after serving since January 2019, including on the Affiliated Transaction Committee and, from 2019 to 2025, the ESG Committee. Senior Independent Director Mary Harris becomes interim Affiliated Transaction Committee member from the same date; the Nomination Committee has begun a search for a new INED under the Articles and Shareholders Agreement. No compensation, ownership, price, or premium terms were disclosed, and no change to control or strategy was indicated, so the event is a routine governance update rather than a special situation.
